title: Spread of marks in a class test
body: A mathematics teacher recorded the marks of 20 students in a class test as a grouped frequency distribution: marks 10-20: 2 students; 20-30: 3 students; 30-40: 8 students; 40-50: 5 students; 50-60: 2 students. She wants a single number describing how far, on average, the students' marks lie from the class mean. She decides to represent each class by its mid-point, find the mean of the distribution, and then take the frequency-weighted average of the absolute deviations of the mid-points from this mean.
